merged_adjudication.closed_predecessor_root: The result contract now binds exact root constants, exact closed authority keys, exact JSON booleans and all authority values false. A synthetic all-PAGE_UNAVAILABLE design witness proves the result algebra is nonempty.

major_finding.minimal_reproduction: A validator can reject every declared zero, zero-point-zero and true case while accepting authority values such as the string false, null, a list, an object, integer one or float one-point-zero.
major_finding.why_current_blocker: The protocol makes the declared case file a mandatory full-entry implementation acceptance oracle, but the file has neither a coverage generator nor a closed mutation grammar from which the missing alias classes can be derived.

manifest_self_hash_finding_not_counted.reason: The immutable candidate and any reviewed execution candidate are externally bound to an exact Git commit and tree. That tree closes the manifest self plus the four non-self payload entries. A recursive self-hash is not required and must not be added.

backtrack_decision.trigger: The remaining failure has moved from experiment semantics to a negative-case DSL and self-governance layer before any page is read.
backtrack_decision.next_design: Freeze a minimal manual-read protocol that reuses the fixed five-page fixture, one source-authored statement container per page, typed literal predicates, four page states and all-false authority, while removing automated verifier acceptance as a page-read prerequisite.
backtrack_decision.draft_rule: Each page may only produce an UNREVIEWED_DRAFT record with authority_effect NONE. A separate reviewer must reopen the exact source and verify speaker, excerpt and literal predicate before any observation is accepted.
backtrack_decision.aggregation_rule: No cross-page count, repeated pattern, demand, buyer, willingness-to-pay, product or transaction inference is permitted.
